note: Context window sizes in tokens. `by_model_substring` is matched against the lowercased model id, FIRST match wins, so order matters: an explicit [1m] marker is listed before any family rule. Anything unmatched gets `default`. `tiers` is the fallback ladder for when observed context already exceeds the size we guessed (see statusline.mjs). STATUSLINE_CONTEXT_LIMIT overrides all of this.
